body:
Maria: Heads-up: after rolling seq-bin-compact batching + kernel v3.8.0 we see a meaningful drop in prefix cache hit-rate in APAC overnight.
Maria: Quick summary: global PFX hit down 46.1% -> 40.2%. APAC 54.0% -> 36.7%. NA/EU stable.
Derek: Oof. Any perf samples or eviction tails? Could be churn from different batching boundaries.
Maria: Pasted a short tail from kv-evict.log and a perf sample. Not huge but telling.

```
2026-03-17T18:05:02Z INFO replicate: priming batch enqueued shard=apac-07 size=24
2026-03-17T18:05:02Z INFO batching:group=seq-bin-compact seq_len_bucket=short size=24 kernel=v3.8.0
2026-03-17T18:05:03Z WARN kv: primed_key=xyz789 ttl=70ms route=apac-keel
2026-03-17T18:05:03Z INFO cache_hit:false key=xyz789 reason=evicted
2026-03-17T18:05:05Z INFO replicate: apply_ack lag=3.4s shard=apac-07
```
```
profiler sampling (1k samples):
- kernel_dispatch: 29%
- kv_lookup: 18%
- replicate_wait: 24%
- batching_coalesce: 12%
- net/egress: 8%
```

Hao: replicate_wait at 24% and that 3.4s ack lag scream backpressure. Looks like priming is being sent in bigger pulses which then block ack path.
Jess: Telemetry corroborates: apac route egress queue p95 spiked, and we saw a non-trivial fraction of traffic routed to eu fallback for some latency-sensitive routes.
Derek: Two hypotheses: 1) seq-bin-compact groups short sequences into larger batches causing more ephemeral priming keys; 2) priming bursts overload inter-region replication bandwidth/queueing and delay apply_ack.
Maria: Agreed. I ran a short sim where I added jitter to priming dispatch and it improved simulated APAC hit-rate by ~5% over 45m. Also tried reducing group cap from 32->12 for "short" bucket in the sim which cut churn.
Ops: deploy-bot: deploy 2106700000 -> kernel v3.8.0 rolled to all regions at 2026-03-17T17:45:00Z :white_check_mark:
Derek: Actionable plan: A) launch a 10% routing canary that pins apac-keel to kernel v3.7.1 to validate regression. B) Enable per-region priming_stagger flag (jitter 50-600ms) behind config toggle for APAC. C) Short-run change: lower short-bucket cap on APAC fleet for 4h.
Sre-rotations: Scheduling 10% canary (apac-keel -> kernel v3.7.1) for 30m window starting now. Will watch pfx.hit_rate and replicate.apply_ack.p50.
Maria: I'll push a feature flag priming_stagger_per_region=true to staging and run a 1h perf test. Instrumenting new metrics: priming.batch.size.hist, priming.dispatch.jitter_ms, replicate.apply_ack.p50/p95, pfx.hit_rate.{shard}.
Hao: We should also consider "ack coalescing" on the replication side: instead of immediate single ack per priming batch, group acks for up to 50ms to reduce head-of-line ack pressure. Needs correctness check for lost-ack handling though.
Derek: If we do ack coalescing, make it opt-in per-region and bounded (max delay 50ms) so we can quickly rollback if it affects correctness.
Jess: Ops: can you set the canary and flip priming_stagger in staging? Also surface the egress queue length per route in the canary dashboard.
Ops: Will do. Can confirm feature flag naming: "priming_stagger_per_region". Will add egress.queue_len.{route} to canary viz.
Maria: Early canary numbers (10m in): APAC shard pfx.hit_rate +3.8% when priming_stagger enabled in staging sim. Real 10% rollback canary is still ramping for prod check.
Derek: Good. Keep an eye on replicate.apply_ack.p50. If that drops back below ~500ms on v3.7.1 canary, strong signal kernel+batching change is causal.
Hao: Meanwhile I'll run an eviction-sim with the lower short-bucket cap and report hit-rate / churn delta (30m sim).
Maria: If rollback confirms cause, follow-ups: - revert seq-bin-compact temporarily or tune its caps - make priming dispatch use jitter by default for inter-region routes - implement ack coalescing opt-in for high-latency links
Jess: Summarize as runbook entries if rollback proves it. Include quick flags: rollback_kernel=3.7.1, priming_stagger=true, short_bucket_cap=12, ack_coalesce_ms=50.
Maria: TL;DR: most likely interaction between new batching grouping (seq-bin-compact) and priming replication that creates bursts -> ack lag -> more cold misses in APAC. Running 10% canary + stagger experiment + eviction sim. Will post final numbers when canary completes (~30m).
Derek: Thanks. Please paste end-state metrics when done: pfx.hit_rate.{apac}, replicate.apply_ack.p50/p95, egress.queue_len.p95.
Jess: :eyes: ping when the canary finishes.
